overview: A beginner roadmap for understanding digital channels, creating simple campaigns, and measuring results with free tools.

phases.title: Marketing Basics
phases.goal: Understand customers, positioning, and common digital channels.

nodes.title: Audience and goals
nodes.description: Define who you are trying to reach and what action you want them to take. Clear goals make every channel easier to use.

nodes.title: Content marketing
nodes.description: Learn how helpful content attracts attention and builds trust. Practice matching topics to customer questions.

nodes.title: Social media channels
nodes.description: Compare how different platforms are used and what content fits each one. Start with one channel before expanding.

project.title: Audience profile and content plan
project.brief: Choose a fictional product, define the target audience, and create a one-week content plan for one channel.

phases.title: Acquisition Channels
phases.goal: Learn SEO, email, and campaign basics.

nodes.title: SEO fundamentals
nodes.description: Learn how search engines match pages to questions. Practice keyword research and writing useful page titles.

nodes.title: Email marketing
nodes.description: Understand list building, subject lines, and simple email sequences. Focus on permission and usefulness.

nodes.title: Landing pages
nodes.description: Learn the parts of a focused landing page, including headline, offer, proof, and call to action. Review examples critically.

project.title: SEO content brief
project.brief: Create a keyword-focused content brief for a beginner blog post, including title, audience, outline, and success metric.

phases.title: Measure and Improve
phases.goal: Track campaign performance and make simple improvements.

nodes.title: Marketing metrics
nodes.description: Learn impressions, clicks, conversion rate, and cost per result. Choose metrics that match the campaign goal.

nodes.title: UTM tracking
nodes.description: Use UTM parameters to identify where traffic came from. Practice building clear campaign links.

nodes.title: Simple reporting
nodes.description: Turn metrics into a short report with results, insight, and next action. Avoid dumping numbers without interpretation.

project.title: Mini campaign report
project.brief: Plan a small campaign, define three metrics, create UTM links, and present a one-page performance report template.
